'''The Fear''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A few years before [[3643 BBY]], another pirate [[Andronikos Revel]] challenged him to a fight and won, getting his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] as a prize.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Fear is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Andronikos Revel companion storyline.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />
